cards.ex: I've always had a soft spot for my younger cousin; he's such a sweet kid.
cards.exUz: Men har doim kichik amakivachchamga mehr qo'yganman; u juda shirin bola.
cards.uzDef: Kimga yoki nimagadir nisbatan iliq his-tuyg'ularga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Even after the divorce, they remained on good terms for the sake of their children.
cards.exUz: Ajrashgandan keyin ham, ular farzandlari uchun yaxshi munosabatda qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir do'stona va yoqimli munosabatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: My parents instilled strong family values in us, like honesty and respect.
cards.exUz: Ota-onam bizga halollik va hurmat kabi kuchli oilaviy qadriyatlarni singdirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari uchun muhim bo'lgan axloqiy tamoyillar.

cards.ex: They've had a rocky relationship for years, but they still love each other.
cards.exUz: Ular yillar davomida murakkab munosabatda bo'lishgan, lekin ular hali ham bir-birlarini sevishadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklar va janjallar bilan to'la munosabat.

cards.ex: Before moving in together, they wanted to get her parents' blessing.
cards.exUz: Birga ko'chib o'tishdan oldin, ular uning ota-onasining roziligini olishni xohlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir roziligini yoki ma'qullashini olish.

cards.ex: Sometimes friends grow apart as they pursue different interests.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan do'stlar turli xil qiziqishlarni ta'qib qilishlari bilan uzoqlashishadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan munosabatlar asta-sekin sovuqlashishi.

cards.ex: I struck up a conversation with the woman sitting next to me on the plane.
cards.exUz: Men samolyotda yonimda o'tirgan ayol bilan suhbat boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir birinchi marta suhbatlashishni boshlash.

cards.ex: I don't know how she puts up with his constant complaining.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlariga qanday chidashini bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Nimani yoki kimni yoqtirmasa ham, sabr bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: We're trying to research our family tree to learn more about our ancestors.
cards.exUz: Biz ajdodlarimiz haqida ko'proq bilish uchun nasl daraxtimizni o'rganishga harakat qilyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining avlodlarini ko'rsatuvchi diagramma.

cards.ex: She's not an adopted child; she's a blood relative.
cards.exUz: U asrab olingan bola emas; u qon qarindoshi.
cards.uzDef: Qon orqali bog'langan oila a'zosi.

cards.ex: He only shares his deepest secrets with his inner circle.
cards.exUz: U faqat eng chuqur sirlarini o'zining yaqin doirasi bilan bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaqin do'stlar va oila a'zolari guruhi.

cards.ex: She's always been a shoulder to cry on when I'm feeling down.
cards.exUz: Men tushkunlikka tushganimda, u har doim dardkash do'st bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordam beradigan, tasalli beradigan do'st.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength; it's like we can read each other's minds.
cards.exUz: Biz doim bir to'lqindamiz; go'yo bir-birimizning fikrlarimizni o'qiy olamiz.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash fikrlashga, bir-birini yaxshi tushunishga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He tried to make amends for his past mistakes by volunteering in the community.
cards.exUz: U jamiyatda ko'ngilli bo'lib, o'tmishdagi xatolari uchun aybini yuvishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga yetkazilgan zarar uchun tuzatish kiritish.

cards.ex: She tends to hold a grudge, which makes it difficult to resolve conflicts.
cards.exUz: U g'azab saqlashga moyil, bu esa kelishmovchiliklarni hal qilishni qiyinlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir xafagarchilikni uzoq vaqt davomida saqlash.

cards.ex: Everyone says they're a match made in heaven; they're so perfect for each other.
cards.exUz: Hamma ularning osmondan tushgan juft ekanligini aytadi; ular bir-birlari uchun juda mos.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda mos keladigan ikkita odam.

cards.ex: Even though they disagree, blood is thicker than water, so they'll always be there for each other.
cards.exUz: Ular kelishmasa ham, qon qondosh, shuning uchun ular har doim bir-birlari uchun yordam berishadi.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari o'rtasidagi munosabatlar boshqalardan ustun turadi.

cards.ex: Having friends in high places can really help you get ahead in your career.
cards.exUz: Nufuzli do'stlarga ega bo'lish sizning karyerangizda oldinga siljishingizga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori lavozimlarda ishlaydigan, ta'sirga ega bo'lgan do'stlar.

cards.ex: Getting my dad to talk about his feelings is like pulling teeth.
cards.exUz: Otamni his-tuyg'ulari haqida gapirishga undash juda qiyin ish.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish juda qiyin yoki juda og'riqli jarayon.

cards.ex: She has a great circle of friends who support her in everything she does.
cards.exUz: Uning hamma narsada uni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan ajoyib do'stlar davrasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Doim birga vaqt o'tkazadigan do'stlar guruhi.

cards.ex: We're looking for a family-friendly hotel with activities for the kids.
cards.exUz: Biz bolalar uchun tadbirlar bilan oilaga mos mehmonxona qidiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari bilan birga qulay va yoqimli bo'lish.

cards.ex: Unfortunately, many friendships fall by the wayside when people move to different cities.
cards.exUz: Afsuski, ko'p do'stliklar odamlar turli shaharlarga ko'chib o'tishganda unutiladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan unutiladigan yoki ahamiyatini yo'qotadigan narsa.

cards.ex: We promised to keep in touch after graduation, but it's been hard.
cards.exUz: Biz bitirgandan so'ng aloqada bo'lishga va'da berdik, lekin bu qiyin bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biringiz bilan doimiy ravishda gaplashib turmoq.

cards.ex: After their argument, they weren't on speaking terms for weeks.
cards.exUz: Ularning janjalidan so'ng, ular haftalar davomida gaplashish darajasida emas edilar.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir gaplashadigan darajada munosabatlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: We had a real heart-to-heart about our future plans.
cards.exUz: Biz kelajak rejalarimiz haqida chin dildan suhbatlashdik.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur va samimiy suhbat.

cards.ex: He was a shoulder to lean on when my grandma passed away.
cards.exUz: Buvim vafot etganida, u tayanch bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatlarda yordam so'rash mumkin bo'lgan inson.

cards.ex: He's proud to carry on the family name.
cards.exUz: U familiyani davom ettirishdan faxrlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari tomonidan meros qilib olingan ism.

cards.ex: They're birds of a feather; they both love hiking and camping.
cards.exUz: Ular bir xil odamlar; ularning ikkalasi ham piyoda sayr qilishni va lager qilishni yaxshi ko'rishadi.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash qiziqishlari va xarakterlari bo'lgan odamlar.

cards.ex: It took me a while to open up to my therapist.
cards.exUz: Mening terapevtimga dardimni aytishim uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga his-tuyg'ularingizni ochib berish.

cards.ex: My grandfather can be a bit of a Dutch uncle, but he always means well.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom biroz tanqidchi qarindosh bo'lishi mumkin, lekin u doim yaxshilikni istaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq tanqid qiluvchi, lekin yaxshilikni istovchi qarindosh.
